Live MLS® listings, updated daily. Move up or down a price range, or see every Langley home.

Langley condos under $499K offer exceptional entry-level opportunities in one of the Fraser Valley's most complete communities. These affordable properties attract first-time buyers, young professionals, and investors with modern amenities, low-maintenance living, and access to excellent schools and parks.

The market includes options from cozy one-bedroom units perfect for singles to two-bedroom family-sized condos, many in well-managed buildings with amenities like fitness centers and visitor parking. Residents appreciate Langley's small-town atmosphere despite growing urban conveniences, including shopping at Willowbrook Mall, diverse dining, and recreation facilities. Many buildings are located near transit routes and close to schools, making daily life convenient without vehicles. The area's walkable downtown, farmers market, and community events create genuine neighborhood connections. Whether you're entering the market or seeking affordable investment, Langley condos deliver value and livability under $499K. Ready to start your search?
